teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Jacksonville jumps four spots to No. 1 after a 42-7 win over the Colts, with a 96 percent shot at the playoffs. The offense (+2.1 points) is the best unit, and next up is a trip to Baltimore as 8.0-point favorites.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Buffalo holds at No. 2 after a 36-10 win over the Ravens, its third straight. The offense is +4.5 points, and the model likes the Bills 2.4 points more than the betting market does.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: San Francisco slips to No. 3 without playing, since it was on a bye and its rating barely moved at -0.0. The offense (+3.6 points) still carries the team, and the Raiders come to town.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: The Rams beat the Chargers 24-9 but still drop a spot to No. 4. At 4-4 their strength of record rank is 18, well behind what the rating says.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle lost 34-17 at home to the Bears and falls to No. 5. The defense (+2.0 points) is the strength, and the offense is slightly below average at -0.1 points.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: Chicago has won 3 straight, the latest a 34-17 win over the Seahawks on the road, and the offense (+1.8 points) is doing the heavy lifting. The Bears are 6-2 with an 82% shot at the playoffs, and they host the Buccaneers in week 9.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: Detroit edged Minnesota 19-15 for a third straight win, but slips one spot to No. 7. The offense is +2.8 points while the defense sits at -0.5.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: Kansas City stays at No. 8 after a 28-24 loss in Denver. The offense is +1.6 points, and the Jets visit next with the Chiefs favored by 8.7.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: New England climbs to No. 9 after a 24-19 road win over Miami. At 5-3, the Patriots host the Packers next, favored by 3.2.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Cincinnati beat Tennessee 43-36 for its third straight win, though the defense at -0.9 points is the obvious worry. The Bengals move up one to No. 10.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: Minnesota is 6-1 with the top strength of record rank, yet falls two spots to No. 11 after losing 19-15 in Detroit. The offense is -2.1 points, and the Bills come to town.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: Tampa Bay shut out Atlanta 16-0 and gained 1.1 points of rating, yet stays at No. 12. At 3-5 the Bucs get a 4.2-point bump from the model over the betting market.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: Green Bay jumps six spots to No. 13 after beating Carolina 27-19. Injuries accounted for +2.0 points of the 2.3-point rating gain, and the Packers visit New England next.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver beat Kansas City 28-24 for its fourth straight win and is 6-2. The rating still has it only at No. 14, with a point differential of 7.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: Pittsburgh won 27-6 over Cleveland, its fourth in a row, and climbs three spots to No. 15. The Steelers are 6-2 but have a rating of just +0.3, and Cincinnati awaits in week 10.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston came off a bye at 2-5 and barely moved, sitting at 16th. The defense (+0.8 points) keeps them afloat while the offense (-0.8 points) drags. The model likes them 3.8 points less than Vegas does, and it has them favored by 2.9 at the Chargers.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas lost 33-30 at home to the Cardinals, who are ranked #27, and stays at 17th. The offense (+2.0 points) is strong, but the defense (-2.2 points) cancels it out. The model has them as 0.4-point underdogs at the Colts in week 9.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: Washington rises three spots to No. 18 after a 27-10 win over Philadelphia. Injuries account for +1.1 points of a 1.7-point rating gain, and the Rams visit next.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: Atlanta fell three spots to No. 19 after a 16-0 loss at Tampa Bay. The offense dropped 0.7 points, and the week's starter at quarterback is still 1.9 points better than their usual situation.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina rises two spots to No. 20 despite a 27-19 loss in Green Bay. Injuries added 1.6 points, and the Broncos visit next.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: Indianapolis has lost four straight, the latest a 42-7 loss to Jacksonville, and sits at 2-6 with a point differential of -61. The Colts slip to No. 21.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: The Jets climb five spots to No. 22 despite a 38-33 loss to the Raiders, their third straight. Injuries (+1.3 points) drove the rating change, and Kansas City is next.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: Baltimore falls nine spots to No. 23, the week's biggest drop. The quarterback situation cost 4.2 points, and the Ravens have lost three straight.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: Las Vegas beat the Jets 38-33 and moves up two to No. 24. The offense gained 0.6 points, but a trip to San Francisco as 11.7-point underdogs is next.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.note: New York was on a bye and slips one spot to No. 25 at 4-2-1. This week's quarterback puts the Giants 1.7 points below their usual situation.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.note: New Orleans fell three spots to No. 26 while sitting out a bye week. The offense is -1.5 points, and the Browns come to town with the Saints favored by 3.0.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona won 33-30 in Dallas and rises two to No. 27. Even so, the point differential is -63, and the defense is the weak spot at -0.9 points.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: Los Angeles is 0-7 after a 24-9 loss to the Rams, with a 0 percent chance at the playoffs. The offense is -3.5 points, and the model is 3.6 points lower than the market.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland drops four spots to No. 29 after a 27-6 loss in Pittsburgh. The Browns are 5-3, but the offense at -2.9 points explains the ranking.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami lost 24-19 to New England and stays at No. 30 at 1-6. The offense is -1.7 points, and the Lions visit next as 7.7-point favorites.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia has lost six straight, the latest 27-10 at Washington, and holds at No. 31. This week's quarterback puts the Eagles 3.8 points below their usual situation.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: Tennessee is last again at 1-7 after a 43-36 loss to Cincinnati. Injuries added 0.9 points, but the offense is -2.7, and Jacksonville comes to town in week 10.
